paragraphs: Work on a big new road in Galway may start in 2028. It is called the Galway City Ring Road.
The road will go around the city. It will cost about €1 billion. Many people hope it will help with traffic.
For years, the plan was stopped by court cases. A local man, Shane Foran, went to court against it. Now he has made a deal with the councils.
He gets promises about greener ways to travel and better traffic. So he has stopped his court case.
Some small jobs, like moving power cables, may start next year. But some home owners on the route are unhappy. They say they are not offered enough money for their land.
sentZh: 高威一條大型新道路的工程可能在2028年開始。
它叫做高威市環城道路。
這條路將環繞城市。
它將花費約10億歐元。
許多人希望它能改善交通。
多年來，這項計畫一直被訴訟擋住。
一位當地男子沙恩·福蘭曾上法院反對它。
現在他已與議會達成協議。
他得到了關於更環保交通方式和更順暢交通的承諾。
所以他撤銷了訴訟。
一些小工程，例如搬移電纜，可能明年開始。
但路線上的一些屋主不滿意。
他們說自己的土地沒有得到足夠的補償金。

paragraphs: Building work on the N6 Galway City Ring Road is now expected to start in 2028, a meeting of Galway City Council heard this week.

The road, which will go around the city, has about €1 billion set aside for it. For years, it was delayed by legal challenges. Recently, an agreement with Shane Foran, a local campaigner for walking and cycling, ended these court cases. In return, the councils promised to improve sustainable transport, traffic flows and some roads.
